capabilities: capture text, recordings, and photos into yearly note files
transcribe recordings with Tencent Cloud speech recognition
count records per year in the note files
move unreferenced plugin-generated media to the vault trash
browse a daily batch of random past records
disambiguation: Does not sync to the flomo web service; it mimics flomo-style quick capture using local vault notes.
extras: README is written in Chinese. Installation is manual: copy the built dist folder into .obsidian/plugins. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Recordings are capped at 100MB and drafts are per-device and per-vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in fast capture flow for logging short text, audio, and images into dated notes, with drafts and later transcription.

relations.evidence: 停用原 Flomo 年度记录计数 插件，避免重复计数
音频发送至腾讯云极速版，需已开通服务及对应额度

requires.name: Tencent Cloud speech recognition service with quota

summary: Quick-capture modal for text, voice recordings, and photos that files entries into yearly notes, with Tencent Cloud transcription and per-year record counts.
